 assert "Exit status: 0" in (root/(arm+".time")).read_text()

  assert (root/arm/"model"/name).read_bytes()==(root/"qr-a/model"/name).read_bytes()

failures=[s for s in log.splitlines() if "linear_failure=" in s]
